title: vtc-types: hosted livestream fields and types
description: From audit JMAP-t8ej.3 (rows 4, 6). Spec commits 6af1b94, 035a9a0, 64976f9, 1e7e6f9, 8cd777e (vtc draft at 77c3474). VTCLivestream gains mode (immutable, default "push"), nullable platform/streamUri/streamKey (null in hosted mode), server-set playbackEndpoints: VTCPlaybackEndpoint[] {protocol, url, credential, expiresAt, latencyHint, timeReference{mediaTimeMs, wallClock}, tracks: VTCStreamTrack[] {kind audio/video/captions/subtitles, language, label, format}, encrypted, keySystems}, and server-set failureReason (timeout/rejected/unavailable/interrupted, null unless failed; stoppedAt also set on failure). Today crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/recording.rs:109-122 has non-null stream_uri/stream_key, so the spec's hosted example fails to deserialize. Open string enums for protocol/latencyHint/kind/mode/failureReason; redact credential in Debug; add playbackEndpoints and failureReason to SERVER_SET and mode (plus platform/streamUri/streamKey per e21c776) to IMMUTABLE (backend.rs:160-163). Oracle: round-trip the draft's hosted and failed examples verbatim. BREAKING (Option fields): CHANGELOG [Unreleased] ### Changed **BREAKING** bullet; regenerate public-api snapshots.
notes: Mark 2026-11-01: not worth holding 0.5.0 for the VTC livestream work; do after the 0.5.0 release (it is breaking in jmap-vtc-types: rides 0.6.0).
